nodes.title: Ribo-Seq/ART-Seq/GTI-Seq
nodes.scope: Illumina explanatory schematic and explicitly supported method variants. The PNG depicts one unbranched route from ribosome-bound RNA through RNase digestion, two separately captioned RNA extractions with intervening rRNA depletion, reverse transcription and cDNA. Sequencing is a catalogue-supported downstream readout. Ribo-Seq/ART-Seq are catalogue aliases at this schematic level, not a claim of identity among all implementations or of exact reproduction of the 2009 experiment. Separate text-only GTI-Seq records retain the LTM initiation-selection distinction and a broad footprint-readout interface from the supplied TISdb paper; they are not additional branches drawn in the PNG. No historical-development or interchangeability edge is inferred.
